d.ko: Swords & Souls: Neverseen is a unique RPG where leveling up takes skill! Create, train and upgrade your character as you please, discover The Neverseen and its eccentric locals, and battle across the lands to foil an evil witch's plans!
d.en: Swords & Souls: Neverseen is a unique RPG where leveling up takes skill! Create, train and upgrade your character as you please, discover The Neverseen and its eccentric locals, and battle across the lands to foil an evil witch's plans!
d.zh:
Swords & Souls: Neverseen 是一款独特的角色扮演游戏，游戏升级需要技巧！按你的喜好来创建、训练和
升级角色，探索 Neverseen，结识古怪的当地人，在这片土地上战斗，挫败邪恶女巫的计划！
